_comment: The hidden flags approximate the reported split of 28 hidden and 27 visible trophies.

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: During cleanup, compare your tracker with the PS5 trophy list and uncheck anything you marked early. If Positive Mental Attitude is locked and you skipped the Chapter 1 balcony, find your chapter-start save before putting more hours into repeatable objectives. Finish the remaining trophies, then confirm the platinum on PS5; the estimate is for this final check, not the full route.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Start a new story save and play Gone Fishing through the closing sequence. Wait until control returns before checking for the unlock, then set aside a separate Chapter 1 save so you can return for the reported balcony meditation if needed.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Keep a manual save from the start of Chapter 1 and leave it untouched as you advance the story. Before closing out the chapter, use the meditation spot on Lucia's balcony: Output Lag reports that it disappears after the transition. Once Chapter 2 begins, verify the chapter trophy and save your new progress in a different slot.

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: When Chapter 2 opens, make a fresh manual save before continuing the campaign. Follow its main-story objectives and check the trophy after the game advances to the next chapter. Keep the earlier save slot intact until the chapter unlock is confirmed.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Resume the main campaign after any side activity and follow its objectives through Chapter 3. Check the trophy when the story advances beyond the chapter, then reserve a new save slot for the next chapter. Avoid overwriting your earlier chapter-start saves while the meditation checklist is unfinished.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Continue the main campaign through Chapter 4 and allow its closing story sequence to finish. Check for the chapter trophy when control returns or the story moves forward. Preserve a separate save before beginning the final mission so the two checkpoints remain available independently.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Before launching the campaign finale, make a separate manual save and leave it available. Follow the final story objectives through the ending sequence without quitting early, then check the trophy list after the result settles. If it does not unlock, reload the pre-finale save and complete the sequence again.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Keep advancing the main plot until Breakfast Run appears, then follow the active objectives for the entire mission. Let its closing sequence complete rather than leaving during the wrap-up. Check the trophy list once the mission is registered as finished.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Take The Cartel Heist when it appears in the campaign and work through its on-screen objectives to the end. Confirm the story trophy after the mission completion registers. Keep this separate from Maximum Withdrawal, which tracks bank-vault escapes rather than this heist.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Continue the main story until Child's Play is the active mission and follow its objective markers in order. Stay with the mission through its closing sequence, then verify the trophy when control returns or the next story sequence begins. Keep side-content detours for after the completion check.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Advance the campaign until Headliners appears, then work through the mission prompts as they arrive. Wait for the mission to finish before checking the trophy list. Keep your chapter-start save until the unlock is confirmed, as the existing notes recommend preserving earlier checkpoints.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: When VCIA Takedown becomes available in the campaign, follow its objectives through the mission's completion. Check for Hi-Jacked after the mission registers. Catch Me If You Can is a separate airport-related trophy, so leave it on your cleanup checklist if it remains locked.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Wait for Operation Savage Glory to appear in the campaign and follow its mission prompts in sequence. Allow the operation to resolve completely, then check the trophy after the story moves on. Keep older save slots until that check confirms the unlock.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: Once the story is complete, review the game's completion tracker and focus on unfinished side objectives that contribute to the total. Check the percentage after each category rather than assuming a task counts. LFCarry reports quotas for vehicle and animal discoveries and challenges, but these figures are unconfirmed in the available notes, so use the in-game tracker as your guide.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Add stunt attempts to ordinary travel across Leonida and note each one only after the game credits it. Check the trophy progress periodically so you know whether the total is advancing. If progress stalls, vary your route and attempts instead of repeating a stunt that has already registered.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: As free roam opens up, try each distinct activity type you encounter and keep a written category checklist. Check the trophy after each new type registers, then seek an unfamiliar category if it remains locked. The available description does not enumerate the categories, so use the in-game activity labels rather than guessing at a total.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: At the Shooting Range, review the result for every challenge and note which ones have not reached gold. Practice those drills first, checking the medal after each run so you do not waste time replaying finished challenges. Before wrapping up, scan the full list for any drill you skipped.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: When you discover a Top Fun venue, enter its drone race and aim for first place. Keep a venue-by-venue list and mark a location only after the win registers. If the trophy stays locked, compare your notes for a venue you have not won at; repeat wins at the same course may not cover the full set.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Record each race event where you finish first while exploring Leonida. For the next attempt, choose a race not already on your list, since the requirement is 20 different wins rather than repeated victories at one event. Check progress after each finish and revisit only races that did not credit a win.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Pick up Cal's fishing challenge during your side-activity sweep and read its scoring rules before starting. Play through the contest and remain through the results screen to verify that your result beats Cal's. If it does not, use the displayed scoring criteria to adjust your next attempt.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: At a playable arcade machine, choose a game and review its controls or rules before starting. Play until the game reaches its completion screen, then check for the trophy before leaving the cabinet. If it does not register, finish another available game and verify again.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: When Andy's first stranger mission appears, begin his strand and note the contact so you can find the follow-ups later. Complete each job in sequence and check for the trophy after the final mission resolves. Count the completed strand toward the eight required for Strangers & Freaks.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Take Kenton's stranger jobs as they appear and complete them in sequence through the final mission. If you pause for other side content, record where the strand stopped so you can resume at the next available job. Verify the trophy after the final mission registers.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Add Billy to your stranger-strand checklist when his first job appears, then follow each subsequent mission attached to him. Keep the contact marked unfinished while other activities are in progress. Check the trophy only after his final mission completes and the strand is done.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Track stranger strands by contact and count one only after its complete job chain is finished. Start with Andy, Kenton, and Billy, whose final missions have individual trophies, then continue with other contacts around Leonida. If your total is short, resume any strand left partway through rather than counting each mission as a separate strand.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Start Randy's stranger jobs when they become available during your side-content route and follow the strand through its later missions. If an encounter ends without an unlock, keep Randy marked as active and look for his next job. Verify the trophy after the final mission resolves.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Begin Tyrone's stranger strand at its first encounter and keep track of each follow-up job. Complete the jobs as they become available, checking the trophy after each finish to see when the strand is complete. Do not mark Tyrone done after an early mission if the trophy remains locked.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.missable_note: Output Lag reports that Lucia's balcony meditation disappears after Chapter 1. Mission replay is unavailable. Keep a manual save at the start of each chapter.
trophies.guide: Before leaving Chapter 1, visit Lucia's balcony and meditate there; Output Lag reports that this spot disappears after the chapter ends and that mission replay is unavailable. Keep a separate early save and use a checklist for the other meditation spots as you explore Leonida. CryptoGames reports 18 spots, but that total is unconfirmed, so rely on the game's progress if available.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Continue Bret's stranger strand until the hunting assignment appears, then follow its directions to identify the unique animal target. Confirm the objective credits the hunt before leaving the activity. If it does not, review the assignment prompt and retry rather than counting an unrelated hunt.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Collect cards while traveling between districts and track each find under its set. Focus on completing three full sets, not just collecting three cards, and use gaps in the collection to guide cleanup. Finish the nearest-to-complete sets first to reduce backtracking.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: Use WAiNK at eligible locations you encounter and record each place only after the game credits it. Divide your route into areas of Leonida and mark each completed stop to avoid repeated visits. Check progress periodically and focus on unlogged locations until the total reaches 100.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: After the story and side activities, review the challenge tracker and list goals already close to completion. Finish those first, confirming each one appears as credited before moving on. Recheck the total after each group so you can stop as soon as 50 challenges are recorded.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Attempt this during free roam when your partner is available, and keep the partner with you through the encounter. Raise the wanted level to four stars, then stay together until the pursuit ends. Check for the trophy only after the heat clears; if the partner is separated or the level drops early, set up another attempt.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Before starting, identify three nearby eligible shops and make sure your partner is with you. Rob them consecutively without letting the wanted level clear between stops, then check for the trophy after the third robbery. If the wanted state drops during travel, treat the chain as broken and start a fresh run.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: As you travel, look for vehicle models your save has not yet credited as discoveries and keep a list of confirmed additions. Check progress after encountering unfamiliar models rather than assuming every vehicle counts. During cleanup, vary your routes and focus on models not already on your checklist until the total reaches 100.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Choose an encounter with at least five enemies available before activating Combat Focus. During that single use, track each takedown and complete all five before the effect ends. If the activation expires early, wait for another suitable encounter and retry.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: During airport cleanup at VCIA, look for an in-game departure interaction and check the trophy after attempting it. The available Exophase and PSNProfiles descriptions do not identify the exact vehicle or trigger, so treat the airport as a lead rather than a confirmed step-by-step solution. If an interaction does not register, continue checking available departures without assuming a specific method.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: When a Rhino becomes available, inspect the vehicle's in-game interaction options and check for the trophy after trying a plausible action. Exophase and PSNProfiles identify the Rhino as the clue, but the exact interaction and location are unconfirmed in the available notes. Do not spend time searching for a particular site based on this guide alone.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Make a manual save before attempting the jewelry-store robbery, then follow the job's stealth prompts and avoid being detected. Check for the trophy when the job ends. If detection is registered, reload your save and retry rather than continuing from a failed stealth run.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Take bank-vault jobs during side-content runs and complete each escape, not just the robbery itself. Record a vault only once the game credits the successful escape, then check progress before repeating a job. If short of five, use your list to find a vault you have not completed.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: When an armored truck encounter appears, follow its on-screen objectives through the full job. Stay with the event until you escape and the game resolves the encounter, then check for the trophy. If it stays locked, look for another encounter and make sure you complete the escape phase.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Let side jobs and collectible routes carry you through different parts of Leonida, and note areas you have not visited. During cleanup, compare your map against your travel history and deliberately sweep the gaps, including places away from your regular paths. Check for the unlock after broadening your exploration rather than repeatedly circling familiar districts.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Before starting an Illegal Operation, check which gang owns it and record that owner on a checklist. Complete operations for different gangs, marking each only after the game credits the job. If the trophy remains locked, target a gang not yet listed instead of repeating a completed owner's operation.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: While visiting Ocean Beach, check venues with a view of the water for an available drink interaction. If a cocktail option appears, order it and check for the trophy before leaving. The available notes do not confirm a specific venue, so treat this as a search through qualifying waterfront spots rather than a guaranteed location.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: If a showroom sequence gives you control of a display vehicle, look for an exit the game allows you to drive through and try to leave in the vehicle. Check for the trophy when the sequence ends. The Exophase and PSNProfiles listings do not confirm which showroom or trigger, so avoid assuming a particular location is correct.

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Visit Kolt & Associates' bowling alley and check the interactions available there. If a bowling game can be started, play it through the results screen and check for the trophy. The available notes do not confirm a required score, so avoid repeating attempts solely to reach an unsupported target.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: Keep this on your story checklist and check for an unlock after campaign sequences involving both leads. The Exophase and PSNProfiles description offers only a partnership clue; the available notes do not confirm a specific activity, choice, or location. Continue the story naturally and revisit the trophy list during cleanup if it remains locked.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: Keep a manual save before a major story decision when the game allows, then let the choice and its outcome play through. Check the trophy list afterward to see whether the decision was credited. Exophase and PSNProfiles specify neither a required choice nor a total, so the available notes do not support a particular decision-grinding route.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: As the story progresses, watch for an encounter that explicitly offers another chance and see it through to its conclusion. Check the trophy after the encounter resolves. The available Exophase and PSNProfiles wording does not identify the event or confirm that failing an unrelated task counts, so avoid relying on random failures.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: Follow unusual encounters that arise while exploring Leonida through to their conclusion, then check the trophy list. The Exophase and PSNProfiles descriptions do not specify an event, location, or timing, so the available notes provide no confirmed waypoint. Keep this on the cleanup list if it remains locked after normal exploration.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Review the controls for vehicle melee before attempting this, then use that action when a target comes within reach. Check for the trophy after a melee hit knocks the target down. A collision is a different action, so if one does not register, retry using the listed melee control instead.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: When a contact offers to launder Marked Bills, use the interaction and record the amount the game credits. Repeat across visits, keeping a running total until credited proceeds reach $250,000. Check the total after each payout so you can stop once the target is met.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Make purchases at shops as you progress and keep a running tally of what you spend. During cleanup, use additional shop purchases to close the remaining gap, checking for the trophy after each one. Stop when the cumulative spend reaches $100,000; the guide does not assume a particular purchase qualifies beyond the stated all-shops requirement.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Reserve some earnings from story and side jobs for garage purchases. Keep a list of garages you have bought, and inspect property listings in other areas during cleanup for ones still missing. Verify the full set in your owned properties before expecting the trophy to unlock.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Once Scooter Bros is available, check the app's registration requirements and note which vehicles it accepts. Register eligible vehicles as you find them and confirm each addition inside the app before counting it. During cleanup, check the registered list and continue until ten entries are recorded.
